مَصْرُورٌ Bound, as a captive. (Mgh.) ―
-b2- And مَصْرُورَةٌ and ↓ مُصَرَّرَةٌ A she-camel having her udder bound with the صِرَار. (IAth, TA.) ―
-b3- And مَصْرُورٌ applied to a solid hoof, Contracted: or narrow: (M, K:) or narrow and contracted: (S:) and ↓ مُصْطَرٌّ signifies the same; (M, K;) or narrow in an unseemly manner, or immoderately. (TA.) ―
-b4- Also (tropical:) A man having an iron collar put upon his neck, or round his neck and hands together. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
